representation: A moving source inside expanding circular wavefronts, with fixed left and right observers, a velocity arrow and a spacing note.
motion: changing speed shifts older wavefront centers farther from the source
changing direction swaps the compressed side
controls: direction slider from left to right
checkpoints: emission stays at the rest frequency
misconceptionTest: The wavefront spacing changes on the two sides while the source label remains f0, so compression comes from motion through the medium, not from a changed emitter frequency; loudness alone cannot explain the spacing change.
accessibility: Wavefront spacing is reinforced by text, both observers and the source are labeled, the direction slider is keyboard accessible, alt text describes the compression, and reduced motion stops the pulse.
